title: Zumo and Quantum Chain Partner to Deploy Quantum-Secure Financial Infrastructure in the UK - Quantum Computing Report
gist: FCA-registered Zumo and blockchain provider Quantum Chain partnered to build quantum-safe financial infrastructure in the UK, combining Zumo's digital-assets API stack with Quantum Chain's post-quantum protocol; no commercial terms are given.

insights.claim: Zumo, an FCA-registered digital asset platform, partnered with Quantum Chain to develop quantum-safe infrastructure for regulated institutions, private networks and digital payments in the UK.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Announcement-level only: no deal terms, customers or timeline are provided.

insights.claim: The initiative combines Zumo's compliant digital-assets-as-a-service API stack with Quantum Chain's post-quantum cryptographic blockchain protocol, with PQC embedded in wallets, institutional trading and fiat on/off-ramps.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: PQC is being packaged as an add-on layer for existing regulated custody and exchange APIs.

insights.claim: Target PQC deployments include CBDCs, tokenized deposits, stablecoins, private financial networks, cross-border settlement and institutional asset management.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The target list is broad and reflects marketing intent rather than live deployments.

insights.claim: The collaboration is aligned with the UK's upcoming cryptoasset regulatory framework and is meant to address cyber risks from cryptographically relevant quantum computers and AI-driven security threats.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Regulatory timing is used as a sales hook for PQC adoption among UK banks and asset managers.
insights.locator: aligns with the UK’s upcoming regulatory framework

insights.claim: Quantum Chain, based in Dubai and Singapore, offers a modular blockchain for regulated finance focused on central bank and institutional use, with quantum-resistant messaging, settlement and private network architecture; the stack aims to guard transaction channels against harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Quantum Chain is a small player seeking UK distribution via a licensed partner.
